system.description: You paint a forbidden sigil on two mirrors.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but the mirrors survive three crossings.
outcomes.success: The mirrors are linked. A creature can step into one and out of the other, however far apart they are. The mirrors shatter after one use.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the paint and time are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The mirrors link, but to a third mirror you never painted, and something watches through it. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
